Welcome to

# HIGH FORCE HOTEL & WATERFALL

### Opening Times

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| High Force Waterfall | Open Daily, 10am - 4pm |
| Hotel | Open Daily |
| Takeaway Kiosk | Open Weekends & Holiday Periods |
| Car Park | Open 24hrs |
| Restaurant | Open daily |

[FAQs](https://www.raby.co.uk/high-force/waterfall/frequently-asked-questions/) [Plan your Day](https://www.raby.co.uk/high-force/waterfall/plan-your-day/)

## Visit

**High Force Waterfall**

- A beautiful circular woodland walking route takes you to the base of one of the biggest waterfalls in the UK, an impressive 21 metres tall.
- Water naturally invites us to slow down, being around water can help to feel more present and grounded. This is known as “Blue Mind”
- Named in the Telegraph’s Most Beautiful Waterfalls in Britain
- Seasonal Children’s Trails
- Woodland sculptures and spaces for children to play throughout
- Accessible route to a view of the waterfall with a bookable tramper available
- Raby Estates App available to download to learn more about the area as you go
- 20 minute walk to the base of the falls or complete the woodland route in just under an hour, depending on pace.

**Adults (16+) £4.00 \| Children (4-15) £2.50 \|Under 4s Free**

**Family Saver Ticket £12.00**

**Adult + Car Parking – £7.00 (25% off parking)**

**Family + Parking – £13.00 (25% off Parking)**

[Book your ticket](https://rabyestate.digitickets.co.uk/event-tickets/39922?branches.branchID=2585)

## Eat

**High Force Restaurant**

- Locally-sourced and exceptionally tasty food all day
- Breakfast, light bites and lunch through to indulgent evening meals
- Afternoon Tea with a three tiered delight of dainty sandwiches, delicious cake and scones with lashings of jam and cream

[Book a table](https://www.raby.co.uk/high-force/hotel/eat/)

## Stay

**High Force Hotel**

- Idyllic rural retreat in picture-perfect, undiscovered Upper Teesdale
- Walk through the doors to open fireplaces, weathered floorboards and effortless, laidback elegance
- Ten boutique bedrooms with bold colours and lavish interiors, each with its own charm
- Renowned for its Upper Teesdale Breakfasts and seasonal dining meals
- Stocked with Temple Spa toiletries to truly relax during your stay
- A short drive away from iconic market towns, Barnard Castle and Middleton in Teesdale
- Surrounded by dramatic landscapes and walking routes with High Force Waterfall adjacent to the Hotel
- Located in one of the premier stargazing areas with some of the darkest skies in the country
- Dog Friendly stays
- Complimentary Tickets to High Force Waterfall and Raby Castle, Park and Gardens when staying at the hotel.

[Book your visit](https://www.raby.co.uk/high-force/hotel/book/)

[**Waterfall**\\
\\
High Force is an incredible sight at any time of the year, however the Winter months can be when you are able to see it at its most powerful, especially after heavy rainfall when it flows with tremendous force.](https://www.raby.co.uk/high-force/waterfall/)

[**Hotel**\\
\\
A traditional country inn set in the picturesque location of Upper Teesdale, The High Force Hotel is a perfect hub for exploring the plethora of things to see and do in the area.](https://www.raby.co.uk/high-force/hotel)

[**Restaurant**\\
\\
We serve locally-sourced and exceptionally tasty food all day, from breakfast, light bites and lunch through to indulgent evening meals. And The High Force Hotel is an elegant yet wonderfully relaxed setting, with open fires and plenty of rustic charm.](https://www.raby.co.uk/high-force/hotel/weddings)

[**Stargazing**\\
\\
Step into a world of wonder as you explore the night sky from some of the darkest and most breath-taking locations in England. From the powerful presence of High Force Hotel & Waterfall to the historic beauty of Raby Castle, Park & Gardens, our stargazing events offer something truly special for every kind of explorer.](https://www.raby.co.uk/high-force/stargazing/)

[**Gift Vouchers**\\
\\
Make an inspired choice this gifting season by choosing a Raby Estate Adventure From Sunday lunches, Moorland Experiences to Stargazing Suppers at High Force Waterfall, a Raby Estates Adventure Gift Voucher is truly something special.](https://www.raby.co.uk/gift-vouchers/)

[**Weddings**\\
\\
Where better can you think of for the perfect waterfall wedding than one of the North of England's greatest natural sights?](https://www.raby.co.uk/high-force/hotel/weddings)

# The Mischievous Elves of High Force Waterfall

**Running daily between Saturday 14th November and Sunday 3rd January**

As you wander through the enchanting woodland trail,  you’ll discover that something has gone terribly wrong…

The mischievous elves have escaped from the workshop and are causing chaos throughout High Force! From getting tangled in twinkling Christmas lights to making a complete mess of the Christmas kitchen, these cheeky elves have been spotted up to all sorts of festive trouble.

[Book Now](https://rabyestate.digitickets.co.uk/event-tickets/39922?branches.branchID=2585)

# Festive Afternoon Tea and Waterfall Walk at High Force Hotel

**Sunday 6th, 13th & 20th December**

Whether you’re gathering with friends, enjoying a cosy family outing, or planning a Christmas treat, our festive afternoon tea offer a magical experience in the country reateat of High Force Hotel. Expect seasonal flavours, a warm welcome, and the perfect backdrop with High Force Waterfall just a short stroll away.

[Book Now](https://www.raby.co.uk/events/festive-afternoon-tea-at-high-force-hotel/)

# Fireside Afternoon Tea and Waterfall Walk

**Monday – Saturday**

Treat yourself to a delicious Afternoon Tea in the heart of the Durham Dales at High Force Hotel.

Indulge in an elegant Afternoon Tea experience, featuring a delightful selection of freshly prepared finger sandwiches, handcrafted cakes and delicate sweet treats, perfectly accompanied by your choice of speciality tea or freshly brewed coffee.

[Book Now](https://www.raby.co.uk/events/afternoon-tea-at-high-force-hotel/)

### Stargazing Suppers

**November 2026 – March 2027**

Join us at High Force Hotel & Waterfall, one of the leading premium, hospitality-led stargazing experiences in England. Begin with a three-course seasonal supper dining experience, before heading out to witness the spectacle of the waterfall illuminated, providing a guaranteed emotional high point.

[Book Now](https://rabyestate.digitickets.co.uk/event-tickets/40866?branches.branchID=2585)

### Family Saver Ticket

Make the most of your adventure with our **Family Ticket** to **High Force Waterfall,** just **£12.**

This great-value ticket gives two adults and two children access to the waterfall, scenic woodland trails, a gentle circular walk, and a fun children’s adventure trail with woodland sculptures.

[Book Now](https://rabyestate.digitickets.co.uk/event-tickets/39922?branches.branchID=2585)

### Stay a little longer…

Watch as winter landscapes settle across Teesdale, transforming into a stunning seasonal escape perfect for countryside adventures, hearty food, and cosy stays. Enjoy our **exclusive 3 nights for the price of 2** **on Dinner, Bed & Breakfast** stays, available from **28th September to 17th December,** the perfect time to unwind beside crackling fires and take in the beauty of the changing season. _Use code WIN26D at checkout._

[Book Now](https://www.raby.co.uk/high-force/hotel/book/)

### Estate Tour

Step into one of **England’s most dramatic and untouched landscapes** and experience the **Durham Dales** like few ever do.

Join us for an exclusive guided estate experience, where you’ll explore the awe-inspiring landscapes of the North Pennines. This experience is designed to immerse you in the natural beauty and rich biodiversity of the moorlands, offering a unique opportunity to learn about and engage with the environment. Led by our estate team the guided tour provides insights into the unique happenings across the Estate.

[Book Now](https://www.raby.co.uk/gift-vouchers/)

### Festive Stargazing

**4th, 5th, 11th, 12th, 18th & 19th December**

Join us at **High Force Waterfall** for a cosy, celestial evening that brings together the beauty of the night sky with the warmth of festive dining. Begin your evening with a **festive three-course supper** in the candlelit surroundings of **High Force Hotel’s Garden Room**, followed by an expert-led journey through the stars.

[Book Now](https://rabyestate.digitickets.co.uk/event-tickets/40866?branches.branchID=2585)

### Festive Dining

**1st – 23rd December**

Nothing brings people together quite like great food at Christmas. With roaring open fires, weathered wooden floorboards and timeless character, **High Force Hotel** is the perfect setting for a cosy festive feast this December. Escape the winter chill, settle into its warm and welcoming atmosphere, and savour seasonal dishes that make every Christmas gathering feel truly special.

[Book Now](https://www.raby.co.uk/high-force/hotel/eat/) [View menu HERE](https://www.raby.co.uk/high-force/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2026/11/High-Force-Festive-Dining-MENU-2026-1.pdf)

### Raby Castle at Christmas Hotel Stay

Join us between the **14th November to 3rd January** and enjoy complimentary access to Raby Castle, Park & Gardens

Raby Castle is opening it’s doors for Christmas for the second time in five decades to showcase the **castle decorated for Christmas**, designed by custodian and creative director, Lady Barnard.

[Book Now](https://www.raby.co.uk/high-force/hotel/book/)

### Luxury Festive Stays

A warm welcome awaits in the heart of the North Pennines National Landscape at High Force Hotel, a beautiful country hotel adjacent one of England’s most iconic waterfalls.

**A Magical Christmas Stay**

[Book Now](https://www.raby.co.uk/events/a-magical-christmas-stay-at-high-force/)

**Twixmas**

[Book Now](https://www.raby.co.uk/events/twixmas-at-high-force/)

**New Year’s Eve Stay**

[Book Now](https://www.raby.co.uk/events/new-years-eve-stay/)

### New Year’s Eve Dining

**31st December**

Looking for a quiet New Year’s Eve away from the crowds? As the year draws to a close, settle into the cosy comfort of our countryside hotel, where weathered floorboards, roaring fires and the gentle warmth of the season create a truly relaxing atmosphere. Spend your evening enjoying delicious food, peaceful surroundings and a chance to bring in the new year at High Force Hotel.

[Book your table HERE](https://www.raby.co.uk/high-force/hotel/eat/)

### Estate Days and Stays Gift Vouchers

Make an inspired choice this gifting season with a Raby Estate Days & Stays Gift Voucher by gifting a unique experience. From Deer Park Safaris in the Castle Grounds, an Estate Tour to some of the Estates most dramatic landscapes in a 4×4 to Stargazing at the base of High Force Waterfall or cooking up a storm with an Estate Chef.

[Book Now](https://www.raby.co.uk/gift-vouchers/)

### Stay and Play

As a guest at High Force Hotel, you’ll receive a special discounted rate on the local course at Barnard Castle Golf Club, **£20 off midweek** and **£25 off weekend tee times.** Whether you’re planning a golfing break, a countryside escape, or a combination of both, staying at High Force Hotel offers a perfect base.

[Book Now](https://www.raby.co.uk/high-force/hotel/book/)

### Raby Estates App

Discover more with The Raby Estates App, explore new walking routes, create your bespoke tour and learn more about geology, wildlife and the history around you.

Reap the benefits with exclusive offers and discounts.

[Download the App](https://www.raby.co.uk/raby-estates-app/)

### North Pennines National Landscapes

High Force is situated within the beautiful Upper Teesdale countryside in the North Pennines National Landscapes. This stunning, upland landscape offers wide-open moors, flower-rich hay meadows, intimate woods, inky-black night skies, curious wildlife, fascinating industrial heritage and tumbling rivers leading to the spectacular High Force Waterfall
